The House

A private residence
with public-house tendencies.

1628 Minturn d/b/a the McMansion is a home in Alameda, California, and—on the right evening—an occasional drinking establishment.

Friends, neighbors, children, refreshments and cold drinks welcome. Reservations neither required nor accepted.

The Halloween Chili Social →

An annual tradition · October 31

The Halloween
Chili Social.

OCTOBER 31

Every Halloween, we throw open the doors, cook as much Cincinnati chili as our pots can handle, and invite friends, neighbors, ghosts, and assorted miscreants to join us.

It's a family tradition, passed down through generations and fueled by questionable amounts of shredded cheddar and sugar.

Stop by for a bowl, stay for a beer, help us pass out candy, or just come haunt the place for a while. No schedule, no ceremony, no pressure.

Costumes encouraged. Commitment discouraged. Chili ensured.
